title: Noelia NDE 3855
content: I was in Physical Education class and was doing the Cooper Test (an endurance test, running laps around a field). The problem is that I am asthmatic and I get tired very quickly. My turn came and after the last lap, I began to feel very sick. A friend of mine asked how many laps I had done and in that moment I couldn't get enough air, my legs started to shake and everything went dark and I fell into the arms of my friend, shaking violently (according to my friend) and I went unconscious. I became aware of a beautiful light. The darkness became clear and there was light. I saw myself there on the ground in the arms of my friend and I could hear echoes of voices. I descended back into my body. I saw a being leaning over me that I can't describe but I am sure it wasn't materially there from accounts from my friends and teacher, the thing is that I was conscious but everything looked blurred, I couldn't move and continued to have convulsions. This experience seemed to last a long time but in reality no more than five minutes had passed according to my teacher who took me to the nearest doctor. Finally, after the initial fright the doctor said that I had suffered an asthma attack and couldn't get enough oxygen to my brain, which had caused the convulsions and caused me to pass out. All of this is the truth as no one should make jokes about these things.

arrival.other_being_detail: A being was seen leaning over her that she "can't describe" and believes was not materially present.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She reports she "descended back into my body."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Asthma attack during a running endurance test; oxygen deprivation led to convulsions and passing out.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She reports hearing "echoes of voices" while out of body, and seeing an undescribed being leaning over her after returning awareness to the body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness/unconsciousness followed by awareness of light; then seeing her body on the ground (OBE); then returning/descending back into the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports being conscious after returning but unable to move, with blurred vision and ongoing convulsions; she also reports hearing "echoes of voices" during the OBE.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I became aware of a beautiful light.”; “I saw myself there on the ground in the arms of my friend and I could hear echoes of voices.”; “I descended back into my body.”
